predictions.articleTitle: Al-Ittihad Kalba vs Sharjah FC Tactical Breakdown & Modeling: Defensive Gaps vs Away Power
predictions.coreRecommendation: Sharjah FC's 2.14 goals-per-match Pro League attack and superior 2.21 single-side goal expectancy support an ordinary Away Win over winless-at-home Al-Ittihad Kalba in a multi-goal contest.
possibilityAssessment: Away Win for Sharjah FC driven by a 2.14 GF/pg vs 2.29 GA/pg Pro League scoring matchup and 57.0% Poisson win share (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Over 2.5 Goals supported by a 3.56 combined lambda total and 69.0% Poisson Over 2.5 probability (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Sharjah's 2.14 goals/game attack targets Kalba's leaky, winless home defense.
